title.value: A debriefing tool to acquire non-technical skills in trauma courses
title.justification: This is the title of the paper.
title.quote: A debriefing tool to acquire non-technical skills in trauma courses

extractions.description: The study reports the use of a nominal group technique (NGT) to evaluate the PEARLS Healthcare debriefing tool as a tool to foster non-technical skills in trauma simulation courses. Additionally, it introduces a debriefing card to be used in trauma courses.
